hints.title: Subordinate Tree Representation
hints.text: Build an adjacency list where each manager points to their direct subordinates.

hints.title: Inform Time as Path Cost
hints.text: The total time for information to reach a subordinate is the cumulative sum of informTime of all supervisors on the path.

hints.title: Find Longest Path
hints.text: Perform a tree traversal from headID to leaves. The answer is the maximum path cost from root to any leaf node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracing backwards from each employee to headID individually incurs quadratic O(N^2) time on tall hierarchies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building the subordinate graph once in O(N) allows a single top-down search in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate constructs the tree and uses top-down traversal to compute maximum path latency.

solutions.approach: top-down tree traversal finding longest latency branch
